proposals.novelty_note: structurally it is the r4_08 conflict-projection family; the metric was the only difference, and the metric provably cannot make a difference

H2_essential_computation.evidence: the Poincare metric is CONFORMAL: g_x = lambda(x)^2 I. For any conformal metric the PCGrad coefficient (dot/||g_rec||^2) is invariant (both terms carry the same lambda^2), so the projected vector is IDENTICAL to Euclidean PCGrad's. Measured: the Riemannian conflict set equals the Euclidean one on all 256 codewords (disagreement 0.0) and the post-projection inner product is -1.1e-11, i.e. the projection succeeds exactly as PCGrad would
H2_essential_computation.proof: g = lambda^2 I  =>  <u,v>_g = lambda^2 <u,v> and ||v||^2_g = lambda^2 ||v||^2  =>  (dot_g / ||g_rec||^2_g) g_rec = (dot / ||g_rec||^2) g_rec
H2_essential_computation.required: a metric-aware gate needs a metric that is NOT a scalar multiple of the identity within the projected coordinates (a learned/Fisher/non-conformal metric, or a block-diagonal product metric with different factor curvatures acting on a shared coordinate block)

H3_curvature_dependence.evidence: the conflict set is exactly invariant to c (the conformal factor cancels in the sign test); measured at c=0 and c=1

H4_real_gradient_optimizer.evidence: the mechanism's effect would be indistinguishable from r4_08's, so no update difference exists to verify

H6_causal_sid_pathway.evidence: the export would change exactly as Euclidean PCGrad changes it

H7_mathematical_oracle.evidence: the invalidation is itself the oracle result: the invariances hold exactly, which is what proves the operator inert

cgv_review.verdict: irrelevant while the operator is invalid

required_revision: reject: any future metric-aware projection must prove the metric is non-conformal in the projected subspace before it is proposed

cross_cutting_findings.statement: In the Poincare-ball model with the conventional conformal metric g_x = (2/(1-c||x||^2))^2 I, the curvature c is a pure scale: the map x -> x/sqrt(c) is an isometry onto the unit ball, so any intrinsic quantity (geodesic distance, parallel transport, the Voronoi assignment) computed on points whose NORMALISED radius sqrt(c)||x|| is held fixed is independent of c.
cross_cutting_findings.measured: the relative deviation of the parallel transport from the identity is 0.5143924039356781 at c=0.25, 1 and 4, and 0.5143924039356785 at c=0.001 (the last-bit difference is float64 rounding), i.e. identical to 15 significant digits
cross_cutting_findings.consequence: a curvature sweep on a Poincare-ball arm is a rescaling of the latent space, which H3 explicitly classifies as a scale-only cosmetic change. Any arm whose hyperbolic claim reduces to 'we changed c' is not making a geometric claim. A genuine curvature effect requires a RELATIVE structure: different curvatures per factor of a product with a COMMON tangent scale, a fixed ambient scale imposed by the host, or a non-conformal metric.
cross_cutting_findings.applies_to: every arm in this repository whose curvature enters only through the conformal metric, including the R10 arm's c=1 declaration; the R10 construction's hyperbolic content is its Busemann level sets (a shape argument), not the value of c, so the finding does not invalidate it, but it does forbid any 'curvature matters' claim based on a c sweep

cross_cutting_findings.statement: For a conformal metric the PCGrad projection is invariant, so 'Riemannian PCGrad in the Poincare ball' is exactly Euclidean PCGrad.
cross_cutting_findings.measured: conflict-set disagreement 0.0 on 256 codewords; the metric ranges over 5.31..324.22, yet the projection coefficient is unchanged
cross_cutting_findings.consequence: this closes a whole direction that looked novel: a metric-aware conflict gate needs a non-conformal metric

cross_cutting_findings.statement: A point outside the ball does not raise: the transport stays finite (finite=True) while the value diverges to 2.4e11 at c||x||^2 = 2.38.
cross_cutting_findings.consequence: H5's usual finiteness check is not sufficient. The verifier and the implementation must assert c||x||^2 <= 1 - margin and declare what happens when the assertion trips (skip the operation, never clamp silently).

cross_cutting_findings.statement: On the synthetic fixture (random codewords, 512 items) the product assignment uses 25 of 256 joint codewords.
cross_cutting_findings.assessment: this is a FIXTURE observation, not a verdict: random codewords in 32 dimensions do not have the structure of a trained RQ-VAE level-0 codebook. It is recorded because a small effective alphabet is the collapse risk H6 watches for, and the real check must run on a real batch once an implementation exists.

cgv_contract_review.shared_gap: G5's non-trace branch measures the encoder gradient only (codebook_deviation is set to NaN there), while all three proposals declare the codebook as the gradient target. Until the engine pools the codebook gradient in the non-trace branch, G5 cannot verify any codebook-targeting mechanism. This is the same structural gap that stopped the R10 arm, and it is now the single most valuable verifier extension for #110.
cgv_contract_review.g2_note: the declared expected_paths describe the host's loss terms; a mechanism-specific path (a factor mask, a transported residual, a projection) is invisible to G2 and must be covered by a mechanism test
cgv_contract_review.g3_note: all three declare mode=invariants because oracles.py has no rule for a product-geodesic assignment, a transport, or a metric projection. A formula-mode G3 requires new independent oracles, which this review does not claim.

what_this_review_does_not_establish: that any candidate would improve ER, G_H1, D2, Recall@10 or NDCG@10 — no training was run, by design
that H4 or H6 hold — both need an implementation, and #111 forbids claiming a passed executable check without one
that the sandbox's reference operators are numerically identical to the eventual implementation — they are the verifier's own implementation of the declared mathematics, which is what H7 checks
that the literature search was exhaustive — the arXiv API answered 429 to all ten queries
